apps.versionDescription: v1.4.6 — Varisai lesson layout restored to the web order: the Laya/Tala row sits above the swara grid again, and Sa, Speed and Labels move onto the playback card. The card (Sa/Speed/Labels, Tempo, Play + Loop) floats at the bottom like a collection accessory — the swaras scroll beneath it and the last line always scrolls clear.
